channel.title: The Golf Channel - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: Arnold Palmer Invitational 2026: Full field finalized with Aon Next 10 and Swing 5
item.description: The field for this year's Arnold Palmer Invitational signature event was finalized after the Cognizant Classic.

item.title: Praising Lowry for facing media after Cognizant collapse
item.description: In this "Golf Channel Podcast with Rex & Lav," Rex Hoggard and Ryan Lavner give praise to Shane Lowry, who faced the media after a crushing defeat at the Cognizant Classic.

item.title: Best of Happy Hour with Smylie at 2026 Cognizant Classic
item.description: Ryan Gerard joined Smylie Kaufman to talk about his adventurous Cognizant Classic, from mud pits to bird scares. Fat Perez also joined to provide some extra entertainment. Check out the best moments from this "Happy Hour with Smylie presented by Michelob Ultra."

item.title: USA Sports extends media rights agreement with PGA of America
item.description: The PGA of America has extended its media rights agreements with USA Sports, news was announced Monday.

item.title: Q&A: Max Homa on battling chronic disease, his game, and why he's hopeful for future
item.description: Homa spoke with Golf Channel as part of a sponsor's campaign to raise awareness for seb derm, a condition that has plagued Homa since his teenage years.

item.title: Where do events like Cognizant fit in a Tour world of 'scarcity'?
item.description: The PGA Tour is promoting "scarcity." What does that mean for a tournament like the Cognizant Classic? Rex Hoggard and Ryan Lavner discuss on "Golf Today."

item.title: Arnold Palmer Invitational 2026: Odds, favorites for Bay Hill Club
item.description: After taking a week off, the top-ranked players in the world return to Bay Hill Club and Lodge for the third signature event of the season. Who is favorited to win?

item.title: What's the state of U.S. golf in the women's game?
item.description: Beth Ann Nichols and Grant Boone join "Golf Today" to talk about the LPGA's start to the 2026 and the current state of U.S. golf in the women's game.

item.title: Whoop shows heart rates on the rise at Bear Trap
item.description: It's no surprise that players get a little anxious when playing the Bear Trap at PGA National. Whoop showed that to be the case at the 2026 Cognizant Classic.

item.title: NCAA highlights: 2026 Darius Rucker Intercollegiate, Round 1
item.description: Extended highlights from the opening round of the Darius Rucker Intercollegiate, featuring some of the top teams in women's college golf.
